summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and announcement dated August 2-3, 2026, appointing Dr. Faisal Miyara as Chief Business Officer and Jim Ziegler as Chief Commercial Officer. Both executives will report to CEO Dr. Dajun Yang. The appointments establish dedicated leadership for U.S. commercialization and global business development. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure or other special-situation event. No deal terms, prices, or advisors were disclosed. What to watch: whether these hires precede U.S. partnership or commercial milestones.
